steps.title: Using the Document collection
steps.subtitle: Session 01 · Building AI applications for research and data
steps.say: This video shows how to open and read the Document collection of training session one.

steps.caption: Open Training in the top menu
steps.say: On the AI for Data site, open Training in the top menu.

steps.caption: Select Document collection under session 01
steps.say: In the sidebar, under session one, select Document collection.

steps.caption: Eight documents, grouped by their role
steps.say: The list shows the eight documents that the notebooks of the session search. The documents are grouped by their role in the worked example.

steps.caption: Select a document to read it
steps.say: Select a document to read it. This country brief covers internet use and mobile subscriptions in Kenya.

steps.caption: The metadata of the document
steps.say: The metadata comes first. It gives the type of document, the country, the date, and the source of the figures.

steps.caption: Chunks and their citations
steps.say: Below the metadata, the document is divided into the chunks that notebook two creates. The label of each chunk is the citation that answers of the application use.

steps.caption: Distractors are on other subjects
steps.say: The distractors are documents on other subjects. In the notebooks, a search that returns the coffee note has failed.

steps.caption: The address ends with the document's id
steps.say: The address of the page ends with the identifier of the document. A copied link therefore opens this document directly.
